question: After the no-op pacing bug is fixed, should outbound recovery keep ambiguous entries pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: Tests can prove the mechanics, but the fail-closed versus recoverable-pending behavior changes operator expectations and must be accepted as product policy.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending After Repair
options.body: Merge after the pacing fix if maintainers want no-adapter ambiguous rows to stay recoverable until adapter reconciliation or the broader ledger ships.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed Behavior
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers prefer terminal failed rows until the full delivery ledger and operator surface are designed.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a Doctor, UI, or API surface before changing ambiguous rows to remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending After Repair
recommendation.body: Merge after the pacing fix if maintainers want no-adapter ambiguous rows to stay recoverable until adapter reconciliation or the broader ledger ships.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses persisted queue semantics, operator behavior, and recent merged recovery changes that steipete merged or authored.
